description: Daily cash price history for one grain commodity in one state, from the same USDA MARS daily reports behind get_grain_price. Use for trends or day-over-day comparison; use get_grain_price instead when only the latest quote matters. Read-only lookup of stored reports; no API key. Returns up to `periods` most recent daily report rows, oldest first; `periods` counts report rows, not calendar days (default 30, max 365).

geography.description: State/region code from a tracked MARS report (e.g. IL, IA, TX, PNW, GULF). Default: IL

periods.description: Number of most recent report rows to return (default 30, max 365)

name: get_grain_history
